title: How a Drunk Man's Night Turned into a Disaster
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On December 10, 2023, an officer pulled over a vehicle due to a missing headlight and suspected impaired driving in Lodi, WI. Upon approach of the vehicle, the man suddenly took off at a high rate. However, he quickly crashed and bailed on foot into the woods. With the assistance of additional units, they were able to locate the man with a thermal imaging device hiding under tree branches. Despite their attempts to apprehend him, he persistently resisted arrest and was about provided with all uses of force. The man ended up being intoxicated and was subsequently arrested for his 6th OWI offense.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
